_about: The channels this publisher posts one video at a time, by their Inbox app name (data.app). An approved video whose app is not listed here (and is not a serialized channel in platforms/youtube.json) is never posted. Where each channel posts comes from post_to in the Inbox Channel config; only the default channel falls back to PLATFORMS when that is empty. follow ends the caption when a card has none of its own; youtube holds that channel's upload settings (categoryId, madeForKids, and optional tags and language for every upload). time (IST, HH:MM) is when its videos go out each day, or times (a list) for several a day; without either, 19:30. News ignores both.
